name: @pipeworx/mcp-traject-ecommerce

tools.name: amazon_product
tools.description: Get Amazon product details by ASIN — title, brand, price, rating, ratings total, bestsellers rank, and image. Uses your Rainforest API key. Example: amazon_product({ asin: "B08N5WRWNW", amazon_domain: "amazon.com", _apiKey: "your-rainforest-key" })

_apiKey.description: Your Rainforest API key (get one at trajectdata.com) — passed as the api_key query param

tools.name: amazon_reviews
tools.description: Get customer reviews for an Amazon product by ASIN — title, body, rating, date, verified-purchase flag, and helpful votes. Uses your Rainforest API key. Example: amazon_reviews({ asin: "B08N5WRWNW", amazon_domain: "amazon.com", _apiKey: "your-rainforest-key" })

_apiKey.description: Your Rainforest API key (get one at trajectdata.com)

tools.name: amazon_search
tools.description: Search Amazon products by keyword — returns position, title, ASIN, price, rating, and ratings total. Uses your Rainforest API key. Example: amazon_search({ search_term: "wireless earbuds", amazon_domain: "amazon.com", _apiKey: "your-rainforest-key" })

_apiKey.description: Your Rainforest API key (get one at trajectdata.com)

tools.name: walmart_product
tools.description: Get Walmart product details by item ID — title, brand, price, rating, ratings total, and image. Uses your BlueCart API key. Example: walmart_product({ item_id: "967006046", _apiKey: "your-bluecart-key" })

_apiKey.description: Your BlueCart API key (get one at trajectdata.com) — passed as the api_key query param

tools.name: walmart_reviews
tools.description: Get customer reviews for a Walmart product by item ID — title, body, rating, date, and verified-purchase flag. Uses your BlueCart API key. Example: walmart_reviews({ item_id: "967006046", _apiKey: "your-bluecart-key" })

_apiKey.description: Your BlueCart API key (get one at trajectdata.com)

tools.name: walmart_search
tools.description: Search Walmart products by keyword — returns position, title, item ID, price, rating, and ratings total. Uses your BlueCart API key. Example: walmart_search({ search_term: "coffee maker", _apiKey: "your-bluecart-key" })

_apiKey.description: Your BlueCart API key (get one at trajectdata.com)

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-traject-ecommerce forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the traject-ecommerce pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
